**Densha de Go! 2** is Taito's 1999 train-driving game, ported to the WonderSwan by CyberFront. It was released only in Japan. You drive the Hokuhoku Line, the Akita Shinkansen, the Osaka Loop Line and the Keihin-Tohoku Line, keeping to the timetable, the signals and the speed limits, and stopping on the mark.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply the .bps to *Densha de Go! 2 (Japan).ws* (4 MB, CRC32 AF9D8F42) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is 4 MB, CRC32 CB01825F; keep the .ws extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Densha de Go! 2 (EN v0.9.1).bps" "Densha de Go! 2 (Japan).ws" "Densha de Go! 2 (EN v0.9.1).ws"

You must provide your own copy of the original Japanese game to apply it.

You can also try the patched game in the browser with the web emulator: https://mariovirgili.github.io/wonderswan-web/

**What is translated**

* Station events (Depart / Stop at / Pass + station) on every route.
* Driving messages and penalties, and the conductor's tips.
* The HUD: signal aspects, sign labels, next-station time, distance.
* Route select, the departure board and the route maps.
* Pause menu, options, continue and game over …
